Metabolism and Dose Adjustment for Zanubrutinib: When co-administered with a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor, reduce the dose of zanubrutinib (a CYP3A4 substrate) to 80 mg orally twice daily. Interrupt the dose as recommended for adverse reactions. After discontinuing the CYP3A4 inhibitor, resume the previous dose of zanubrutinib. 2. Metronidazole and Acetaminophen: Metronidazole increases the level or effect of acetaminophen by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2E1 metabolism. This interaction applies to oral, intravenous, and rectal forms of acetaminophen. The clinical significance of this interaction is minor or unknown. 3.
